_note: worker_name is a DECLARATION, checked against wrangler.toml [env.production] name. If the two disagree the sync aborts. Every key the vault holds must appear in secret_names or in not_synced with a written reason; one in neither aborts the sync by name.

not_synced.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: The credential this sync authenticates WITH. Uploading it to the Worker would put the key that can rewrite every secret inside the thing it rewrites.
not_synced.RUNWAY_API_KEY: Video generation, driven from her Mac by the slate tooling. No Worker route reaches it.
not_synced.CAL_ICS_SEQ_TAYLOR: Calendar feed URL read by the local calendar:sync job, not by the Worker.
not_synced.CAL_ICS_WESTPEEK: Calendar feed URL read by the local calendar:sync job, not by the Worker.
not_synced.CAL_ICS_STAYLOR_SPRY: Calendar feed URL read by the local calendar:sync job, not by the Worker.
not_synced.CAL_ICS_CRYPTOCLEARR: Calendar feed URL read by the local calendar:sync job, not by the Worker.
not_synced.CRYPTOCLEARR_IMAP_PASSWORD: IMAP password used by the local mailbox sweep. The Worker receives mail through Cloudflare Email Routing and never opens an IMAP connection.
not_synced.SOS_IMAP_PASSWORD: IMAP password used by the local mailbox sweep. Same reason.
not_synced.WP_OS_NETWORK_OS_SESSION_SECRET: Belongs to West Peek OS, a different application. Boss OS carries West Peek chassis code by copy and diverge and must never hold its credentials.
not_synced.KDP_ACCOUNT_EMAIL: Amazon KDP sign-in, used only by the Mac-side KDP scripts (scripts/ops/kdp-signin.mjs, kdp-surface.sh). No Worker route reads it.
not_synced.KDP_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD: Amazon KDP sign-in, used only by the Mac-side KDP scripts (scripts/ops/kdp-signin.mjs, kdp-surface.sh). No Worker route reads it.
not_synced.WP_NETWORK_OS_INTAKE_SECRET: West Peek OS credential (WP_ prefix); nothing in Boss OS reads it. Boss OS must never hold another application's credentials.
not_synced.WP_OS_MAC_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID: West Peek OS credential (WP_ prefix); nothing in Boss OS reads it. Boss OS must never hold another application's credentials.
not_synced.WP_OS_MAC_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET: West Peek OS credential (WP_ prefix); nothing in Boss OS reads it. Boss OS must never hold another application's credentials.
not_synced.WP_OS_SECRET_HANDOFF_KEY: West Peek OS credential (WP_ prefix): its own secret door's key, in the shared Mac vault since 6 Oct 2026. Nothing in Boss OS reads it; Boss OS has its own, BOSS_OS_SECRET_HANDOFF_KEY. Unclassified, it made every Boss OS sync abort.

synced_reasons.GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: Moved from not_synced on 19 Sep 2026. Owner: "it should never send — the green button should be to create the draft." The Worker creates a Gmail DRAFT in her own mailbox on her press (src/worker/boss/wealth/gmailDraft.ts), which needs the gsc-bot service account under the gmail.compose scope she granted the same day. One scope, one endpoint (drafts.create); spry-vc-never-sends.mjs and the-inbox-draft-never-sends.mjs fail the build if a send scope or send endpoint appears on that path. Until this is synced the card prints the NAMED STOP "the Worker holds no Google key".
synced_reasons.BOSS_OS_SECRET_HANDOFF_KEY: Added 6 Oct 2026 (docs/SERVICE_RULES.md R3). The AES-256 key the Worker encrypts a key she emails as `SECRET NAME=value` under, until her Mac moves it into the vault. Without it on the Worker the secret door fails closed.
